Top candidates: **Pythium_damping_off** (soft rot, water-soaked decay) vs **Rhizoctonia** (firm, dry reddish-brown cankers at soil line).

The soft, decayed appearance fits Pythium (water-soaked soft rot) rather than Rhizoctonia (which would be a distinct dry, firm reddish canker).
